sloka: सम्स्तभ्य धैर्येण स्थिरचित्तो भवाम्यहम् ।ब्रह्महत्याकृतम् पापम् हृदयादपनीयताम् ॥२-६३-५२॥
transliteration: samstabhya dhairyeṇa sthiracitto bhavāmyaham ।brahmahatyākṛtam pāpam hṛdayādapanīyatām ॥2-63-52॥

translations.english: 'I am now calm. I bear my pain with patience. Remove the fear from your mind that you have committed a sin by slaying a brahmin.
